name: LRT3 Shah Alam Line
area: Bandar Utama to Johan Setia, Klang (corridor)
status_detail: Operational · opened 29 June 2026; free rides through 31 July 2026
summary: The 37.8 km light rail line from Bandar Utama to Johan Setia, Klang, serving Shah Alam and the western Klang Valley. Cost reported at RM21.93 billion.
why_it_matters: The first rail spine through Shah Alam. It connects the west of the valley (Klang) to the established Kelana Jaya line, changing commutes and land value along the whole corridor.
questions_to_follow: Do ridership numbers in the first year match projections?
Does transit-oriented development appear around the new stations?
location_precision: Corridor-level entry. Marker placed at the Bandar Utama end; station-by-station coordinates pending.

sources.title: LRT3 Shah Alam line: Everything you need to know before it opens

history.event: Transport Minister confirms opening at the end of June.
Line opens; free rides until 31 July 2026.
